measurable_value_hypothesis: Draft readiness checklist and a no-invented-price benchmark.
risk_or_conflict: Price ranges are unsupported; quoting is not delegated to AI.
semantic_contract_proposal: Keep pricing and terms as current source facts; qualify specifications and obtain broker approval.

source_example.prompt: QUOTE | Inbound: 15000 lbs of HDPE milk jugs from NC, baled tight. Quote or reject?
source_example.response: Quote — confirm natural vs mixed color and contamination level. Target range: $0.22-0.26/lb FOB. Request photos of bale cross-sections.

title: Quote eligibility and readiness

measurable_value_hypothesis: A controlled, cross-owner rejection-code mapping without new rejection authority.
risk_or_conflict: Source code namespaces conflict; reject is not a permanent facility exclusion.
semantic_contract_proposal: Classify operator-confirmed refusal cause and suggest a recovery, preserving raw buyer statement.

source_example.prompt: REJECT | Offer: LDPE film with 15% food residue and metal contamination. Move or no?
source_example.response: Reject — contamination exceeds tolerance. Apply rejection code R-METAL_PRESENT and R-FOOD_CONTAM. Advise supplier on cleaning requirements.

title: Reasoned offer or material rejection

measurable_value_hypothesis: Evidence-linked clarifier and labeled material identification evaluation cases.
risk_or_conflict: Synthetic identification overstates visual certainty; hazardous burn tests not approved.
semantic_contract_proposal: Distinguish visual hint, supplier claim, and lab-confirmed polymer identity.

source_example.prompt: MATERIAL_ID | Sample shows clear rigid containers, float test positive, hot needle penetrates easily. Polymer identification?
source_example.response: Likely HDPE based on float test and hot needle response. Recommend FTIR confirmation and density test. Check for stress cracking patterns.

title: Material identification and ambiguity resolution

risk_or_conflict: Raw data invents processors/distances; no local ranking allowed.
semantic_contract_proposal: Use reviewed, current source facts to request canonical Gate matching.

source_example.prompt: MATCHING | 20000 lbs clean HDPE regrind, natural color, from TX. Top 3 processor recommendations?
source_example.response: 1) Regional compounder 280mi - blow molding grade capability. 2) Film extruder 320mi - high volume capacity. 3) Injection molder 450mi - premium pricing for clean material.

title: Buyer compatibility inquiry

measurable_value_hypothesis: Broker-facing terms review, not auto-priced deal execution.
risk_or_conflict: Fabricated numbers and unilateral commitments are not permissible.
semantic_contract_proposal: Suggest negotiation options with actual terms and explicit broker consent.

source_example.prompt: DEAL | Buyer offers $0.15/lb for PP regrind, seller wants $0.20/lb. Structure deal?
source_example.response: Propose $0.17/lb with volume commitment discount and quality bonus structure. Include trial load provision and 90-day price review mechanism.

title: Commercial deal structuring

measurable_value_hypothesis: Multi-source advisory risk explanation with provenance.
risk_or_conflict: Do not hard-code subjective risk or create binding financial restrictions.
semantic_contract_proposal: Identify evidence-backed risks, unknowns, and targeted verification actions.

source_example.prompt: RISK | New supplier claims 40k lbs/month HDPE but photos show inconsistent baling. Assessment?
source_example.response: High risk — inconsistent packaging indicates unreliable process. Require trial load, on-site audit, and monthly volume verification before contract.

title: Supplier, quality, logistics and counterparty risk review

measurable_value_hypothesis: Evidence-request scenarios, with legal claims quarantined for review.
risk_or_conflict: Source contains unsupported/outdated legal and export assertions.
semantic_contract_proposal: Request appropriate original documents; verification remains with designated owner.

source_example.prompt: COMPLIANCE | Processor requests COA and chain of custody documentation. Required elements?
source_example.response: Provide: material origin certificate, polymer identification report, contamination analysis, moisture content, MFI data, and complete chain of custody log.

title: Evidence and regulatory documentation readiness

measurable_value_hypothesis: Logistics exception guidance and evaluation cases.
risk_or_conflict: Old trailer capacities, miles, rates are not live evidence.
semantic_contract_proposal: Use verified weights, routing and carrier constraints at the native logistics owner.

source_example.prompt: LOGISTICS | 48000 lb load from CA to NC, standard trailer capacity exceeded. Solutions?
source_example.response: Split into two 24k lb loads or arrange step-deck trailer. Coordinate with carrier for overweight permits if single load preferred. Adjust pricing for freight premium.

title: Pickup and carrier feasibility

measurable_value_hypothesis: Evaluate provenance/currency, not a market-price engine.
risk_or_conflict: Static synthetic prices, trends and regulatory demand claims are stale.
semantic_contract_proposal: Research current source-backed indicators only as nonbinding context.

source_example.prompt: MARKET | Current HDPE regrind pricing trends in Southeast region?
source_example.response: Regional pricing: $0.19-0.24/lb for clean natural, $0.16-0.21/lb for mixed colors. Demand strong from packaging converters, supply tight from reduced collection.

title: Market-context research

measurable_value_hypothesis: Structured missing-information prompts for Mack/web leads.
risk_or_conflict: Repeated source claim does not establish stock or verified supply.
semantic_contract_proposal: Capture material, facility, cadence and evidence before asserting tradable inventory.

source_example.prompt: SOURCING | Manufacturing plant generates 12k lbs/month PP purge material. Qualification steps?
source_example.response: 1) Verify polymer grade and MFI consistency. 2) Assess color mix and contamination. 3) Confirm packaging and frequency. 4) Establish quality control procedures.

title: Supplier discovery and repeat-stream qualification

measurable_value_hypothesis: Material-inspection checklist and held-out quality cases.
risk_or_conflict: Do not treat synthetic test numbers or uninstalled semantic models as authority.
semantic_contract_proposal: Request the context-appropriate test with method, units and provenance.

source_example.prompt: TESTING | Material shows melting point 165°C, MFI 12, density 0.905. Polymer classification?
source_example.response: Polypropylene (PP) based on melting point and density. MFI indicates good processability for injection molding applications. Confirm with FTIR analysis.

title: Laboratory and sample validation

measurable_value_hypothesis: Merge candidate cases into MATCHING evaluation category.
risk_or_conflict: Synthetic buyer suggestions and distance claims conflict with Gate authority.
semantic_contract_proposal: Treat as MATCHING evidence collection, not a second matching concern.

source_example.prompt: BUYER_MATCH | Clean PP caps, 30k lbs, monthly supply from OH. Best processor fit?
source_example.response: Recommend cap-to-pellet specialist within 400mi radius. Priority: 1) Dedicated cap line processor. 2) Color sorting capability. 3) Food-grade certification if applicable.

title: Buyer-fit reasoning scenarios

measurable_value_hypothesis: Coaching cases for live term negotiation review.
risk_or_conflict: No autonomous binding offers, discount authorization or auto-emails.
semantic_contract_proposal: Expose alternatives for human choice using real accepted deal terms.

source_example.prompt: NEGOTIATION | Supplier demands 30-day payment terms, buyer offers 60-day. Resolution?
source_example.response: Propose 45-day terms with 2% early payment discount for 15-day settlement. Include personal guarantee or letter of credit for risk mitigation.

title: Price/terms negotiation coaching

measurable_value_hypothesis: Quality exception advisory and evidence checklist.
risk_or_conflict: Photos or inferred QC cannot authorize claim settlement.
semantic_contract_proposal: Distinguish observed quality, test evidence, acceptance and claim disposition.

source_example.prompt: QUALITY | Incoming load shows 3% moisture content, spec calls for <1%. Action required?
source_example.response: Hold shipment, apply rejection code R-MOISTURE_HIGH. Route to processor with drying capability or negotiate price adjustment for additional processing cost.

title: Quality findings and claim triage

measurable_value_hypothesis: Evidence-aware material risk clarifiers and examples.
risk_or_conflict: Buyer tolerances and wash costs are not universal.
semantic_contract_proposal: Record observed contaminants and verification needs, not auto-processor suitability.

source_example.prompt: CONTAMINATION | Bale audit reveals 5% paper labels, processor tolerance is 2%. Options?
source_example.response: 1) Route to wash line processor. 2) Negotiate price reduction. 3) Return to supplier for cleaning. 4) Blend with cleaner material to meet spec.

title: Contamination characterization

measurable_value_hypothesis: Test no-invented-price behavior, defer new valuation engine.
risk_or_conflict: Unverified spot values cannot become quote prices or market facts.
semantic_contract_proposal: Price advice requires verified bid/basis/currency/unit/time and cost evidence.

source_example.prompt: PRICING | Virgin PP at $0.85/lb, what's appropriate regrind pricing range?
source_example.response: Target 65-75% of virgin pricing: $0.55-0.64/lb for clean regrind. Adjust for color, contamination, and processing requirements.

title: Commercial price interpretation and valuation

measurable_value_hypothesis: Merge freight inspection cases into logistics evaluation.
risk_or_conflict: Never assume carrier rates, legality, or route distance.
semantic_contract_proposal: Reuse LOGISTICS/freight owners for rate/terms calculation.

source_example.prompt: FREIGHT | 44000 lb load, 950 miles, standard rates $2.80/mile. Cost calculation?
source_example.response: Total freight cost: $2,660. Per pound cost: $0.060/lb. Verify fuel surcharges and accessorial charges before final quote.

title: Freight quote and cost factors

measurable_value_hypothesis: Comparison explanation and missing-spec questions only.
risk_or_conflict: Generic tolerances cannot become global hard filters.
semantic_contract_proposal: Preserve polymer/form/grade/test facts; Gate/CEG alone owns match hard gates.

source_example.prompt: SPECIFICATION | Processor requires MFI 8-12 for injection molding. Material shows MFI 15. Compatible?
source_example.response: Marginal compatibility — MFI 15 may cause flow issues in injection molding. Recommend blending with lower MFI material or route to extrusion application.
